title: CONVERGENCE integration spike plan
goal: Prove that a ciefa-style tick, IdleKit economy, a bounded Yggdrasil capability graph and an inkjs dilemma can coexist around ONE plain TypeScript GameState, with a save/load round trip and a Control-Loss flag that blocks a previously valid action.
nonGoals: No content authoring beyond one dilemma and five nodes

pinnedVersions.@idlekitjs/economy: 0.1.1 (MIT) - latest published; the repo declares unreleased 0.3.1
pinnedVersions.@idlekitjs/mechanics: 0.3.2 (MIT) - latest published; import SUBPATHS only, never the barrel
pinnedVersions.zod: 4.x for CONVERGENCE save schema; Yggdrasil pins zod 3.x internally - do not unify, keep the boundary

measuredBundleCost.note: @idlekitjs/core is NOT pulled in by any mechanics subpath we need, despite mechanics declaring it as a hard runtime dependency (the Random import lives in the pickups/crafting/boosts chunks).

interfaces.GameState: type GameState = { meta: MetaState; economy: EconomySlice; world: WorldSlice; anomaly: AnomalySlice; controlLoss: ControlLossSlice; capabilities: { yggdrasil: TreeState | null }; narrative: { inkJson: string | null; lastChoiceId: string | null }; meta2?: never }
interfaces.MetaState: { seed: number; rngCounter: number; tickNumber: number; lastTickTime: number; playtimeMs: number; gameVersion: string }
interfaces.AnomalySlice: { financial: number; compute: number; energy: number; logistics: number; public: number }  // 0..1 per channel
interfaces.ControlLossSlice: { financial: boolean; compute: boolean; energy: boolean; logistics: boolean; public: boolean }  // true = contained
interfaces.TickInputs: { currentTime: number; deltaMs: number; actions: PlayerAction[]; offlineEfficiency?: number }
interfaces.TickSystem: { name: string; advance(draft: GameState, inputs: TickInputs, emit: Emit): void; skipOffline?: boolean }
interfaces.EffectEnvelope: { kind: 'anomaly' | 'resource' | 'capability' | 'directive' | 'log'; channel?: AnomalyChannel; magnitude?: number; capabilityId?: string; text?: string }
interfaces.InkEffectSink: class InkEffectSink { queue: EffectEnvelope[]; emit(id: string, payload?: string): void; drain(): EffectEnvelope[] }

adapters.name: ConvergenceEconomy
adapters.responsibility: Register Compute/Capital/Energy/Autonomy via stateKey-style accessors that read and write nested slices. Never stores state.

adapters.name: CapabilitySubsystem
adapters.responsibility: Construct TreeEngine(treeDef, { initialState, timeNow }) at boot from gameState.capabilities.yggdrasil; expose canUnlock/unlock/lock; write getSnapshot() back into GameState on every mutation.

adapters.name: InkAdapter
adapters.responsibility: Load compiled JSON, bind emit_effect into an InkEffectSink, expose continue/choose; after Continue() the ConsequenceResolver drains the sink. Narrative code may never touch GameState directly.

adapters.name: ConsequenceResolver
adapters.responsibility: Single mutation funnel: apply(EffectEnvelope[]) -> GameState. The ONLY component allowed to translate narrative and system intent into state changes.

adapters.name: ControlLossRequirements
adapters.responsibility: Five predicates (financialControlAvailable, ...) plus allOf/not composition. Attached to directive transactions.

adapters.name: CapacitorSaveStorage
adapters.responsibility: Implements { read(slot), write(slot, payload), listBackups(), restore(id) }. The only place that knows about the platform.

executionSequence: 1. createInitialState(seed) builds a plain GameState with capabilities.yggdrasil = null and narrative.inkJson = null.
2. Bootstrap: build ConvergenceEconomy, build CapabilitySubsystem (TreeEngine with initialState = gameState.capabilities.yggdrasil ?? fresh), build InkAdapter with the compiled dilemma JSON.
3. Scheduler.start() calls advance({ currentTime, deltaMs }) once per second; advance drains queued actions and runs tick(draft, inputs).
4. tick(): Phase A runs actions through applyAction -> IdleKit executeTransaction; Phase B runs systems (produceCompute, advanceHazard); meta accounting increments tickNumber and lastTickTime.
5. advanceHazard uses createTickRng(draft) and computes p = 1 - exp(-lambda * deltaT) per channel; on hit it emits an EffectEnvelope rather than mutating directly.

6. Player triggers the dilemma: InkAdapter.continue() renders text and choices; choosing calls story.ChooseChoiceIndex(i), which invokes the bound external function emit_effect('CONSEQUENCE:LAUNDER', 'financial').

7. ConsequenceResolver drains the sink and applies the effect: raises anomaly.financial, then - if the threshold is crossed - sets controlLoss.financial = true and calls CapabilitySubsystem.lock('cap:banking-access').

8. The next attempt to run the 'route-capital' directive calls economy.execute(state, tx). The transaction carries requirement financialControlAvailable; the preview now returns a TransactionFailure of kind 'requirement-failed' and nothing is mutated.
9. saveManager.serialize(state) wraps the state in the envelope, writes through CapacitorSaveStorage; reload calls deserialize -> migrate -> zod validate -> rehydrate the three subsystems.
10. Acceptance test asserts determinism, round trip, and the blocked action.

acceptanceTests.name: deterministic tick
acceptanceTests.assert: Two runs with the same seed and the same 600 tick script produce byte-identical serialized GameState.

acceptanceTests.name: single source of truth
acceptanceTests.assert: After 100 ticks there is exactly one GameState object graph; IdleKit economy holds no balances, Yggdrasil StateStore is reachable only through CapabilitySubsystem, and Pinia (not part of the spike) would hold references only.

acceptanceTests.name: save / load round trip
acceptanceTests.assert: serialize -> JSON string -> deserialize yields a deep-equal GameState; fnv1a hash matches; capabilities.yggdrasil and narrative.inkJson survive.

acceptanceTests.name: offline catch-up
acceptanceTests.assert: simulateOffline(state, t + 8h) advances the simulation in chunks, respects the cap, and does not run systems flagged skipOffline.

acceptanceTests.name: narrative emits effects, never mutates
acceptanceTests.assert: Running the dilemma produces at least one EffectEnvelope in the sink; GameState is unchanged until ConsequenceResolver.apply() runs. No ink external function other than emit_effect is bound.

acceptanceTests.name: control loss blocks a previously valid action
acceptanceTests.assert: route-capital executes successfully before containment; after controlLoss.financial = true the same transaction returns ok: false with a 'requirement-failed' failure carrying a human label, and no balance changes.

acceptanceTests.name: capability graph + exclusive branch
acceptanceTests.assert: Graph of 5 nodes with 1 exclusion edge: unlocking one side makes canUnlock() fail on the other with an explainable reason; CycleDetector reports no cycle.

acceptanceTests.name: migration path
acceptanceTests.assert: A v1 envelope is migrated to the current version and still validates; a future-version envelope fails with FUTURE_VERSION rather than silently loading.

deliberatelyExcluded: @idlekitjs/core Engine and ReactiveStore - they own the state
@idlekitjs/storage - duplicates ciefa persistence responsibility; backends are localStorage/memory only
@yggdrasil-forge/* editor, react, cli, analytics, neo4j, search, heatmap - irrelevant to a mobile game
inkjs /full and the compiler - build-time only, must not reach the bundle
